The '''Special Restraint Cells''' was a section of the [[Maximum Security Section]], a sector of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Belsavis prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The area was designed to hold [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] that required special restraints beyond the standard setup for most prisoners; [[Maximum Security Pod J-P7|Maximum Security Pods J-P7]], [[Maximum Security Pod J-P8|J-P8]] and [[Maximum Security Pod J-P8|J-P9]] were located in the area, as was [[Solitary Confinement]].
